blocks.x: Food processors live on quality, yield and traceability: intake grading, process yield, food-safety evidence and provenance claims. Vision grading, yield analytics and chain-of-custody convert commodity margin into brand margin. This page is the operating picture: what runs, what strains, and which capabilities move the numbers that decide the margin.

The work concentrates in intake grading, process yield analytics, lot traceability, with cold-chain monitoring close behind. Volume grows on every path; the decision layer has not kept up. That gap is measurable, and it is the work.
For Agri-Food Processing, as operators describe it:

items: Quality grading by inspectors; variance and throughput loss.
Process yield by line/lot unknown; losses accepted.
Plant networks flat; food-safety systems targeted.
